description: This is a PHP class file defining the ViewMyDetailsController within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the PIM module. It handles redirecting a logged-in user's request to view their personal details.

classes.name: ViewMyDetailsController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling requests to view the authenticated user's personal details and redirecting appropriately.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request by retrieving the authenticated user's employee number and redirecting to their personal details page.
